title: DaemonConfig
description: Local startup configuration for an AgentDesktop daemon.

controller.description: Controller connection settings. Omit this field to run without fleet management.

inferenceGateways.description:
Named inference gateways used as the local desired-state baseline.

Names may contain letters, numbers, `.`, `-`, and `_`.

programs.description: Per-program settings used as the local desired-state baseline.

ClaudeCodeConfig.description: Settings reconciled into Claude Code's managed configuration.

inferenceGateway.description: Name of an entry in `inferenceGateways` that Claude Code should use.

ControllerConfig.description: Connection settings for the fleet controller.

address.description: HTTP or HTTPS address of the controller's fleet API.

caCertificatePath.description:
Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the controller.

Omit this field to use the operating system's trusted certificate roots.

heartbeatInterval.description: Interval between device heartbeats. Defaults to `30s`.

InferenceGatewayAuthentication.description: Authentication mechanisms supported by an inference gateway.

oneOf.description: Request a short-lived JWT from the controller using the device identity.

audience.description: Audience placed in the issued JWT. This must match the gateway's expected audience.

InferenceGatewayConfig.description: Connection and authentication settings for an inference gateway.

authentication.description: Authentication mechanism used when connecting to this gateway.

url.description:
Base HTTP or HTTPS URL of the inference gateway.

The URL must include a host and cannot include credentials, a query, or a fragment.

ProgramsConfig.description: Settings for developer tools managed by AgentDesktop.
